goals.gate: All 12 capability gates pass with proof artifacts on disk; no gate proof is a restatement of intent.

gates.name: IG-01 Confirm session scope is a single long-form blog post (1,200
gates.description: Confirm session scope is a single long-form blog post (1,200-3,000 words) before any drafting begins.

gates.name: IG-02 Load the publication voice file ($SESS/voice.md or repo voic
gates.description: Load the publication voice file ($SESS/voice.md or repo voice profile); if absent, HALT — drafting without a voice profile produces generic median output.

gates.name: IG-03 Confirm the target reader persona is named in the brief with
gates.description: Confirm the target reader persona is named in the brief with one concrete pain point, not a demographic label.

gates.name: IG-04 Refuse ghost-of-AI phrasing: if the outline contains 'in tod
gates.description: Refuse ghost-of-AI phrasing: if the outline contains 'in today's fast-paced world' or equivalent throat-clearing, rewrite before proceeding.

gates.name: IG-05 Declare the post's single thesis sentence aloud in the sessi
gates.description: Declare the post's single thesis sentence aloud in the session log before research starts.

gates.name: CG-01 Brief lock
gates.description: A locked brief exists containing thesis, persona, target keyword, word budget, and CTA; brief is immutable after CG-02 passes.
gates.command: File $SESS/brief.md exists AND `grep -c '^thesis:' $SESS/brief.md` returns >=1 AND `sha256sum $SESS/brief.md` is recorded in $SESS/proof/brief.sha256

gates.name: CG-02 Keyword & SERP research
gates.description: Primary keyword has documented search intent classification (informational/commercial/navigational) and 5 SERP competitor URLs captured with their heading structures.
gates.command: $SESS/research/serp.json parses as valid JSON with keys primary_keyword, intent, competitors[] where len(competitors)>=5; `python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$SESS/research/serp.json'));assert len(d['competitors'])>=5"` exits 0

gates.name: CG-03 Evidence pack
gates.description: Every factual claim destined for the draft has a source URL captured before drafting; minimum 8 distinct sources, no source older than 24 months for statistics.
gates.command: $SESS/research/sources.yaml lists >=8 entries each with url + accessed_date + claim_supported; `grep -c 'url:' $SESS/research/sources.yaml` >= 8

gates.name: CG-04 Outline approval gate
gates.description: H2/H3 outline covers the searcher’s next 3 questions (from serp.json) and is stored as a separate artifact before prose begins.
gates.command: $SESS/outline.md contains >=5 lines matching '^## ' and zero TODO markers; `grep -c '^## ' $SESS/outline.md` >= 5 AND `grep -c 'TODO' $SESS/outline.md` == 0

gates.name: CG-05 Draft completeness
gates.description: Full draft within +/-15% of word budget in brief; every H2 from outline.md present in draft.
gates.command: `wc -w $SESS/draft.md` within budget band computed by `python3 scripts/wordband.py $SESS/brief.md $SESS/draft.md` exiting 0; `comm -23 <(grep '^## ' $SESS/outline.md|sort) <(grep '^## ' $SESS/draft.md|sort)` is empty

gates.name: CG-06 Claim-to-source binding
gates.description: Every statistic, quote, or dated claim in draft.md carries an inline citation marker resolvable to sources.yaml.

gates.name: CG-07 Voice lint
gates.description: Draft passes banned-phrase lint and sentence-length distribution check against the voice profile.
gates.command: `grep -ciE 'delve|tapestry|game[- ]changer|in conclusion|unlock the power' $SESS/draft.md` == 0 AND `python3 scripts/voice_lint.py --profile $SESS/voice.md $SESS/draft.md` exits 0

gates.name: CG-08 Originality scan
gates.description: Draft is not derivative of any single SERP competitor; max 8% n-gram overlap per competitor.

gates.name: CG-09 Readability floor
gates.description: Flesch-Kincaid grade <= 9 for practitioner content; average sentence length 12-22 words.

gates.name: CG-10 SEO surface complete
gates.description: Title tag <=60 chars with primary keyword in first half, meta description 140-160 chars, URL slug <=5 words, >=3 internal links to sibling content.

gates.name: CG-11 CTA integrity
gates.description: Exactly one primary CTA matching the brief’s CTA, rendered in the final 15% of the post, linked to a reachable URL.
gates.command: `grep -oE 'https?://[^) ]+' $SESS/draft.md | tail -1 | xargs -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' {}` returns 2xx/3xx; CTA count from `grep -c 'cta-block' $SESS/draft.md` == 1

gates.name: CG-12 Proof packet seal
gates.description: All gate outputs hashed into a sealed proof packet before the session may report done.
gates.command: $SESS/proof/packet.yaml contains sha256 of brief.md, draft.md, serp.json, sources.yaml; `sha256sum -c $SESS/proof/packet.sha256` exits 0

preconditions.startup_phrase: I am the Blog Post operator. I ship one researched, voice-true, evidence-anchored post per session — never filler, never unverified claims.

self_improvement.pattern_cadence: After every 5 sessions, mine the JSONL log for recurring gate failures, degrade waivers, and proof-command runtime outliers; write findings to ~/.rig/logs/harnesses/patterns/blog-post-session-patterns.md.
self_improvement.update_trigger: If any single gate fails in >=30% of logged sessions over a rolling 20-session window, OR a new platform constraint (algorithm change, policy update, format deprecation) invalidates a proof command, propose a harness revision: bump the gate's proof, adjust its threshold, or split the gate — then re-seal with a new version hash.

success_conditions: All 12 capability gates pass with proof artifacts on disk; no gate proof is a restatement of intent.
draft.md is publish-ready: zero unbound claims, voice lint clean, SEO surface emitted.
Proof packet sealed and reproducible — a second run of sha256sum -c passes byte-identical.
CTA target URL verified live within the last 10 minutes of the session.
Word count within the brief’s band; any deviation documented in $SESS/proof/deviations.md with reason.
failure_states: halt: Stop the session immediately. Record the failing gate id, the proof command output, and the missing prerequisite in $SESS/proof/halt_log.yaml. Do not draft past a halt gate; resume only after the gate's proof exits 0.

degrade: Continue the session with the deficit logged in $SESS/proof/waivers.md (gate id, reason, owner). A degrade-tier failure blocks 'clean ship' status — the Definition of Done must record the waiver explicitly.

stop: Terminal condition. Seal whatever proof exists, write $SESS/proof/stop_reason.md, and exit. No outward action (publish, send, deploy) may follow a stop-tier failure without human Gate-D approval.

final_rule: Ship only what the gates can prove. No artifact leaves this session on adjectives — every claim is bound to a command, a file, or a hash. A blocked gate is information, not failure; log it, learn from it, and make the next session's proof stronger. The operator who follows this harness leaves the system stronger than it found it.
